notes.title: 2024/02/29 Update Patch
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.
Version 1.0.4 has been updated.

- Correct errors that do not display normally when playing in a 21:9 environment
- Allows you to skip production when playing multiple times
- Improve the level design and environment of some areas
- Corrects the phenomenon where it is no longer possible to proceed if only the box is dropped from the elevator area.

Thank you for your continued support of Gravitia.
